summary: Short kerb on a bend beside a junction, with houses 12-15 m behind.

best_section.where: North kerb of Stanley Terrace on the bend, past the side-street junction, below the solar-panel house

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 12 m and 15 m away on the same side, behind hedges and palms; the pool house is just beyond.
drivers.access_and_room: Parallel kerbside lane wide enough to pull fully off; 14 m of usable kerb, enough for a van.
drivers.traffic: Busy through road with a junction and a bend; a car is parked at the kerb in the QLD image.
drivers.convention: No signs mapped on this stretch. Few cars park here, so a van would stand out more than on the signed stretches nearby.

flags: Close to a junction, so visibility and turning traffic
Homes 12-15 m away on the same side
sun_shade: Palms and hedge give partial shade from the north-east; the kerb is otherwise open to sun.
cannot_judge: Whether any no-stopping rule applies near the junction
